title: Viva La Vida
description: 《Viva la Vida》描寫一位失去權力的君王，回望昔日榮耀與今日落寞的巨大反差。歌中的主角曾經君臨天下、掌控一切，卻在權力崩塌後變得孤獨無助，甚至開始懷疑自己過去的選擇。他回想群眾的歡呼、戰爭與革命，也逐漸明白權力其實並不穩固，如同建立在沙土上的城堡，隨時可能倒塌。宗教與歷史意象則加深了他對罪責、命運與救贖的思考。最終，《Viva la Vida》傳達的是對權力、失敗與人生無常的反思：再強大的地位也可能瞬間失去，真正值得思考的，是人在失去一切後如何重新理解自己的人生。

vocabulary.usage: 談以前常做、但現在不再做的事情。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Used to」？
options: I used to visiting art shows every Friday.
I used to ride my bike to school, but now I take the bus.
I used to go to school tomorrow.
She used to is my teacher.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：以前騎車上學，現在改搭公車。
optionExplanations: used to 後用原形 visit，不能接 visiting。
正確：以前騎車上學，現在改搭公車。
錯誤：used to 談過去，不能搭配 tomorrow 說未來的安排。
錯誤：used to 後面要接 be，不能接 is。

vocabulary.usage: 談國王統治國家，或某人管理一個地方時。
options: I rule to the small country.
We rule at the bus every morning.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：女王統治這個國家。
optionExplanations: 正確：女王統治這個國家。
rule 表示統治時直接接國家，不加 to。
過去事件須用 ruled。
錯誤：rule 不能表示等公車，應說 wait for the bus。

vocabulary.meaning: 下令；發出開始行動的指示
vocabulary.usage: 當負責的人說可以開始、出發或採取行動時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Give the word」？
options: When the coach gives the word, we start running.
The coach give the word yesterday.
I give the word my book to Anna.
She gives the word in her bag with her keys.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：教練一下令，大家就開始跑。
optionExplanations: 正確：教練一下令，大家就開始跑。
過去事件須用 gave the word。
錯誤：若是把書交給 Anna，應說 give my book to Anna。
錯誤：give the word 不是把「字」放進包包。

vocabulary.meaning: 擲骰子；也可以比喻冒險一試
vocabulary.usage: 玩桌遊時，或在不知道結果的情況下決定試一試。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Roll the dice」？
options: I rolled the dice to chose who starts.
My cousin roll the dice yesterday.
We rolled to the dice before the game.
Let’s roll the dice and see who goes first.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：用擲骰子決定誰先開始。
optionExplanations: to 後用 choose，不能接 chose。
過去事件須用 rolled。
roll the dice 直接接 dice，不加 to。
正確：用擲骰子決定誰先開始。

vocabulary.usage: 音樂會、街道、球賽等有很多人聚在一起的地方。
options: I drank a crowd of water after running.
A big crowd waited outside the shop.
She crowd to the concert yesterday.
A crowd are one person waiting alone.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：很多人在商店外面等。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：crowd 是人群，不是水的量。
正確：很多人在商店外面等。
此處需要描述人群的完整結構，不能用 crowd to 表示前往演唱會。
crowd 指一群人，與 one person waiting alone 的意思衝突。

vocabulary.meaning: 掌握關鍵；擁有解決問題的辦法
vocabulary.usage: 表示某人或某件事對成功或解決問題非常重要；也可指真的拿著鑰匙。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Hold the key」？
options: Practice holds the key to passed the test.
Good sleep hold the key to feeling better.
Practice holds the key to winning this game.
She hold the key to be very tall yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: hold the key to 指掌握達成某事的關鍵。
optionExplanations: to 在此是介詞，後接 passing，不能用 passed。
單數主詞 good sleep 配 holds。
hold the key to 指掌握達成某事的關鍵。
錯誤：主詞和動詞不一致，句子意思也不自然。

vocabulary.meaning: 發現；找到原本不知道的事
vocabulary.usage: 找到新地方，或知道以前不知道的事情時。
options: I discover to a quiet beach on our trip.
We discovered a small café near our school.
He discovered to dinner at seven.
She discovers the door closed with a pencil.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：我們發現學校附近有一間小咖啡館。
optionExplanations: discover 直接接發現的事物，不加 to。
正確：我們發現學校附近有一間小咖啡館。
錯誤：discover 不能表示去吃晚餐。
錯誤：discover 不是把門關起來的動作。

vocabulary.meaning: 不知道為什麼；因為某個不明的原因
vocabulary.usage: 不知道事情發生的原因，但想描述它時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「For some reason」？
options: For some reason, my phone stopped working.
For some reason, my uncle forget his name yesterday.
She bought for some reason in the market.
For some reason is my new pencil.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：手機不知為什麼突然不能用了。
optionExplanations: 正確：手機不知為什麼突然不能用了。
過去事件須用 forgot。
錯誤：bought 後面缺少買的東西；片語不能代替受詞。
錯誤：這個片語不能直接當成「我的新鉛筆」的主詞。

vocabulary.usage: 強風吹倒樹木、圍欄或其他東西時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Blow down」？
options: We blow down to the library by bus.
I blew down to the airport yesterday.
She blows down the song on the radio.
The strong wind blew down an old tree.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：強風吹倒了一棵老樹。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：搭公車去圖書館要說 go to，不是 blow down。
blow down 指風吹倒某物，不能表示前往機場。
錯誤：不能用 blow down 表示播放或聽歌曲。
正確：強風吹倒了一棵老樹。

vocabulary.usage: 描述一個人會說實話，或希望對方坦白時。
options: I put an honest on my head when it rains.
My cousin honest about the broken camera.
Please be honest with me about what happened.
He honest the window before leaving.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：請誠實告訴我發生了什麼事。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：honest 是形容詞，不是可以戴在頭上的東西。
honest 是形容詞，前面需要 was 等動詞。
正確：請誠實告訴我發生了什麼事。
錯誤：honest 不是動詞，不能表示關窗。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 以前曾經做某事，通常與現在形成對比。
questions.usage: 比較以前與現在的習慣或情況。
questions.prompt: 以前住在山邊，現在住在城裡。哪句正確？
options: I use to lived near the hills.
I will used to live near the hills.
I used to live near the hills, but now I live downtown.
I used to living near the hills.
optionExplanations: 錯：應用 used to live，不是 use to lived。
錯：will used to 不能表示未來。
正確：used to 後接 live，並和現在的住處形成對比。
錯：used to 後不是 living。
questions.explanation: 正確：used to 後接 live，並和現在的住處形成對比。

questions.word: would＋原形動詞：過去反覆發生
questions.meaning: 在往事敘述中，可表示過去經常發生的動作；歌詞還有誇張比喻。
questions.usage: 回憶以前反覆發生的事情，需有過去語境。
questions.prompt: 說小時候祖父常說故事，哪句正確？
options: Grandpa would told us stories every night.
When I was little, Grandpa would tell us stories.
Grandpa would to tell us stories.
My grandpa would telling stories when I was small.
optionExplanations: 錯：would 後不能接 told。
正確：過去時間加 would tell 表示反覆習慣。
錯：would 後不加 to。
錯：would 後應接 tell。
questions.cue: “Seas would rise when I gave the word”
questions.explanation: 正確：過去時間加 would tell 表示反覆習慣。

questions.meaning: 交代過去某件事發生的時刻。
questions.usage: 敘述另一件事發生時的背景。
questions.prompt: 燈熄了時，大家安靜下來。哪句正確？
options: When the lights turned off, everyone quiet.
When the lights went out, everyone became quiet.
When the lights went out, everyone becoming quiet.
When the lights off, everyone was quiet.
optionExplanations: 錯：everyone 後缺少 was 或其他動詞。
正確：when 引導過去事件，主句也採過去式。
錯：主句需要 became，不是單獨 becoming。
錯：子句缺少動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：when 引導過去事件，主句也採過去式。

questions.word: 現在式與過去習慣對比
questions.meaning: now 標示現在，現在簡單式描述現況或習慣。
questions.usage: 對照從前與現在生活的不同。
questions.prompt: 以前有人接送，現在自己走路。哪句正確？
options: Now I walked home every day yesterday.
Now I walking home every day.
Now I am walk home every day.
Now I walk home every day.
optionExplanations: 錯：now 和 yesterday 在此形成時間衝突。
錯：現在進行式缺少 am，且本題強調習慣。
錯：am 後不能接原形 walk。
正確：現在簡單式 walk 描述每天的習慣。
questions.cue: “Now in the morning I sleep alone”
questions.example: in the morning I sleep alone
questions.explanation: 正確：現在簡單式 walk 描述每天的習慣。

questions.word: 省略關係代名詞的受詞關係子句
questions.meaning: 修飾名詞時，若關係詞是受詞，可以省略。
questions.usage: 描述以前認識、看過、使用過的人或物。
questions.prompt: 那本我昨天借的書很好看。哪句正確？
options: The book I was borrow yesterday is great.
The book I borrowed yesterday is great.
The book I borrowed it yesterday is great.
The book I borrowing yesterday is great.
optionExplanations: 錯：was borrow 的動詞形式不對。
正確：book 是 borrowed 的受詞，省略關係詞仍通順。
錯：book 和 it 重複充當受詞。
錯：需用 borrowed 表達昨天借書。

pattern.text: 名詞 +（省略 that／which）+ 主詞

questions.example: the streets / I used to own
questions.explanation: 正確：book 是 borrowed 的受詞，省略關係詞仍通順。

questions.word: hear＋受詞＋現在分詞：聽見動作進行
questions.meaning: 聽見某個聲音或動作正在發生。a-ringing 是古風、節奏化的歌唱形式。
questions.usage: 聽到別人正在唱歌、敲門等。
questions.prompt: 我聽到隔壁有人正在唱歌。哪句正確？
options: I can hear my neighbor singing next door.
I hear my neighbor to sing next door.
I hear my neighbor is singing next door directly after hear.
I hear my neighbor sings next door.
optionExplanations: 正確：hear + 人 + singing 表示聽見正在唱。
錯：此感官結構不用 to sing。
錯：直接接在 hear + 受詞後時，不用 is singing；可另說 I hear that...。
錯：作受詞補語時不能用 sings。
questions.explanation: 正確：hear + 人 + singing 表示聽見正在唱。

questions.meaning: 描述此刻正在進行的動作。
questions.usage: 談眼前正在發生的活動。
questions.prompt: 現在演員正在舞台上跳舞。哪句正確？
options: The actors are dance on stage now.
The actors are dancing on stage now.
The actors dancing on stage now.
The actors is dancing on stage now.
optionExplanations: 錯：are 後須接 dancing。
正確：複數主詞搭配 are dancing。
錯：缺少 are。
錯：複數 actors 不搭配 is。
questions.explanation: 正確：複數主詞搭配 are dancing。

questions.meaning: 對聽話者發出請求、指示或鼓勵；歌詞使用象徵意象。
questions.usage: 邀請別人參與某件事。
questions.prompt: 要請朋友加入小組，哪句正確？
options: You be joining our team, please.
optionExplanations: 正確：動詞原形 Join 開頭。
錯：這不是自然的祈使句形式。
錯：祈使句應以 join 開頭。
錯：不定詞片語不是完整祈使句。
questions.cue: “Be my mirror, my sword and shield”
questions.explanation: 正確：動詞原形 Join 開頭。

questions.word: for some reason：原因不明的狀語
questions.meaning: 表示出於某個原因，但原因尚不清楚；後面的 I can’t explain 修飾 reason。
questions.usage: 說明沒有查明理由的意外事件。
questions.prompt: 手機突然停止充電，原因不明。哪句正確？
options: For some reason, my phone stopped charging.
For some reason is my phone broken yesterday.
For some reason my phone to charge.
My phone for some reason charging stopped it.
optionExplanations: 正確：片語置句首，後接完整子句。
錯：整句結構與時態錯亂。
錯：缺少完整動詞結構。
錯：語序不自然，stopped it 多了受詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：片語置句首，後接完整子句。

questions.meaning: 表示能力不足或目前無法做到。
questions.usage: 表達難以回答、看見或解釋的事情。
questions.prompt: 這題太難，我無法回答。哪句正確？
options: I can’t to answer this question.
optionExplanations: 錯：can’t 後不加 to。
錯：不能接 answering。
錯：不能接 answered。
正確：情態動詞後接原形 answer。
questions.explanation: 正確：情態動詞後接原形 answer。

questions.word: once＋過去完成式：在某事已發生後
questions.meaning: once 表示一旦／當……之後；you’d 在此是 you had。
questions.usage: 回顧過去兩件有先後次序的事情。
questions.prompt: 大家離開後，房間變安靜。哪句正確？
options: Once they had leave, the room was quiet.
Once they had leaving, the room was quiet.
Once they had left, the room was quiet.
Once they were left, the room was quiet.
optionExplanations: 錯：had 後需過去分詞 left。
錯：had 後不能接 leaving。
正確：had left 表示先離開；was quiet 是其後狀態。
錯：were left 表示被留下，語意改變。
questions.explanation: 正確：had left 表示先離開；was quiet 是其後狀態。

questions.meaning: 表示過去某個地方或情況曾有／沒有某事。歌詞跨行形成一句。
questions.usage: 回憶活動現場沒有空椅子。
questions.prompt: 昨天戲院沒有空位。哪句正確？
options: There were no empty seats yesterday.
There was no empty seats yesterday.
There were no empty seat yesterday.
optionExplanations: 正確：there were + 複數名詞 seats。
錯：複數 seats 應搭配 were。
錯：缺少 be 動詞。
錯：複數 seats 才能搭配 were。
questions.explanation: 正確：there were + 複數名詞 seats。

questions.word: that was when＋子句：指出往事時間
questions.meaning: 回指某段過去時間，說明當時發生的事。
questions.usage: 回憶一個特別的夏天。
questions.prompt: 那就是我學會游泳的時候。哪句正確？
options: That was when I learn swim yesterday.
That was when I learning to swim.
That was when did I learn to swim.
That was when I learned to swim.
optionExplanations: 錯：learn 後通常需 to swim，且過去需 learned。
錯：缺少 be 動詞且時態不對。
錯：間接時間子句不用 did I 倒裝。
正確：when 後用直述句語序與過去式。
questions.cue: “that was when I ruled the world”
questions.explanation: 正確：when 後用直述句語序與過去式。

questions.meaning: 強調主詞受到動作影響，而非誰執行；此處有被困住的詩意畫面。
questions.usage: 報告門窗被關閉的情況。
questions.prompt: 暴風雨來前，所有窗戶都被關上。哪句正確？
options: All the windows were close before the storm.
All the windows were closed before the storm.
All the windows was closed before the storm.
All the windows were closing by someone before storm.
optionExplanations: 錯：被動式需 closed。
正確：複數 windows + were closed。
錯：複數主詞不搭配 was。
錯：were closing 表示進行，非本題完成的被動。
questions.explanation: 正確：複數 windows + were closed。

questions.meaning: 說明發現一項事實；that 可以在一般口語中省略。
questions.usage: 說出經過檢查才知道的事。
questions.prompt: 我發現門沒有鎖。哪句正確？
options: I discovered that the door unlocked.
I discovered that was the door unlocked.
I discovered that the door was unlocked.
I discovered that the door to unlock.
optionExplanations: 錯：需要 was 連接主詞與形容詞。
錯：多放 was 且語序錯誤。
正確：that 後是 the door was unlocked 完整子句。
錯：不定詞不能取代陳述句。
questions.explanation: 正確：that 後是 the door was unlocked 完整子句。

questions.meaning: 用不定詞表示行動目的；前句主詞因歌詞省略，並非完整標準句。
questions.usage: 表達開門是為了讓人進來。
questions.prompt: 她打開大門讓客人進來。哪句正確？
options: She opened the gate to letting the guests in.
She opened the gate for let the guests in.
She opened the gate to let the guests in.
She opened the gate for to let the guests in.
optionExplanations: 錯：目的用 to let，不是 to letting。
錯：for let 不正確。
正確：to let 說明開門的目的。
錯：for to let 不符合一般現代英語。
questions.cue: “Blew down the doors to let me in”
questions.explanation: 正確：to let 說明開門的目的。

questions.meaning: let 表示允許或讓某人做某事；let me in 中 in 作方向副詞。
questions.usage: 邀請客人進入。
questions.prompt: 保全讓我們進大廳。哪句正確？
options: The guard let we enter the hall.
The guard let us enter the hall.
The guard let us entering the hall.
The guard let us to enter the hall.
optionExplanations: 錯：受詞應是 us，不是 we。
正確：let us enter，受詞後接原形。
錯：此結構不能接 entering。
錯：let 後不接 to enter。
questions.explanation: 正確：let us enter，受詞後接原形。

questions.meaning: 表示過去無法相信／不能做到。
questions.usage: 形容聽到消息後難以相信。
questions.prompt: 我聽見好消息時簡直不敢相信。哪句正確？
options: I couldn’t to believe the news.
optionExplanations: 正確：couldn’t + 原形 believe。
錯：couldn’t 後用 believe。
錯：不能接 believing。
錯：不能加 to。
questions.explanation: 正確：couldn’t + 原形 believe。

questions.meaning: what 引導名詞性子句，採陳述句語序；I’d 在此是 I had。
questions.usage: 描述別人驚訝於你的變化。
questions.prompt: 朋友看到我做的畫，驚訝我進步多少。哪句正確？
options: My friends were surprised what I had make.
My friends were surprised what had I made.
My friends were surprised by what I had made.
My friends surprised by what I had made.
optionExplanations: 錯：had 後需 made。
錯：名詞子句不倒裝 had I。
正確：what I had made 是完整間接子句。
錯：主句需要 were。
questions.explanation: 正確：what I had made 是完整間接子句。

questions.meaning: would 可呈現假設、反問或不可思議的語氣；ever 加強疑問。
questions.usage: 委婉反問誰會願意在雨中等候。
questions.prompt: 這麼冷，誰會想站在外面？哪句正確？
options: Who would want to stand outside?
Who would wants to stand outside?
Who would wanting to stand outside?
optionExplanations: 錯：would 後不能直接接 to stand；需主動詞 want。
正確：would want to + 原形 stand。
錯：would 後不能用 wants。
錯：would 後不能用 wanting。
questions.cue: “who would ever want to be king?”
questions.explanation: 正確：would want to + 原形 stand。

questions.meaning: 表達願望、目標或意圖。
questions.usage: 說自己想參加明天的活動。
questions.prompt: 我想參加明天的工作坊。哪句正確？
options: I want to join the workshop tomorrow.
I want joining the workshop tomorrow.
I want to joining the workshop tomorrow.
I want join the workshop tomorrow.
optionExplanations: 正確：want to join。
錯：此句型不接 joining。
錯：to 後需原形 join。
錯：want 後少了 to。
questions.explanation: 正確：want to join。

questions.meaning: 否定將來預期；歌詞引用宗教人物，不應擅自推定具體神學意義。
questions.usage: 預測朋友明天不會來。
questions.prompt: 她明天不會來參加會議。哪句正確？
options: She won’t coming to the meeting tomorrow.
She won’t comes to the meeting tomorrow.
She won’t come to the meeting tomorrow.
She won’t to come to the meeting tomorrow.
optionExplanations: 錯：不接 coming。
錯：won’t 後須原形 come。
正確：won’t + come。
錯：不能加 to。
questions.explanation: 正確：won’t + come。

questions.meaning: 兩個形容詞並列修飾同一名詞；歌詞以擬人語氣形容風。
questions.usage: 描寫一個溫暖又安靜的房間。
questions.prompt: 我們找到一間明亮又安靜的房間。哪句正確？
options: We found a brightly and quiet room.
We found a bright and quiet rooms.
We found a bright and quietly room.
We found a bright and quiet room.
optionExplanations: 錯：brightly 是副詞。
錯：a 後不接複數 rooms。
錯：quietly 是副詞，不能如此修飾 room。
正確：bright、quiet 都是修飾 room 的形容詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：bright、quiet 都是修飾 room 的形容詞。

questions.word: 過去完成式縮寫 I’d＝I had
questions.meaning: I’d 可是 I had 或 I would，要由後接動詞判定；本句是 had become。
questions.usage: 回想客人抵達前已完成的工作。
questions.prompt: 在客人到之前我已經收拾完桌子。哪句正確？
options: I had cleaning the table before the guests came.
I had clean the table before the guests came.
I had cleaned the table before the guests came.
I have cleaned the table before the guests came yesterday.
optionExplanations: 錯：had 後不能接 cleaning。
錯：had 後需 cleaned。
正確：had cleaned 是過去完成式，先於 came。
錯：有明確過去先後時此題需 had cleaned。
questions.explanation: 正確：had cleaned 是過去完成式，先於 came。

questions.word: 現在簡單式動詞第三人稱單數
questions.meaning: 複數主詞使用 stand，不加 -s；與單數主詞 stands 對照。
questions.usage: 說明固定的位置或事實時使用。
questions.prompt: 描述兩座塔位在河邊。哪句正確？
options: The two towers stands by the river.
The two towers is standing by the river every year.
The two towers standing by the river.
The two towers stand by the river.
optionExplanations: 錯：複數主詞不加 stands。
錯：複數不搭配 is，且此句描述固定位置。
錯：缺少完整謂語動詞。
正確：two towers 是複數，現在式 stand。
questions.explanation: 正確：two towers 是複數，現在式 stand。

questions.meaning: one minute 搭配下一句 next，對比局面迅速改變；不是逐字表示只有六十秒。
questions.usage: 形容天氣突然改變。
questions.prompt: 剛才天氣晴朗，轉眼就下雨。哪句正確？
options: One minute it was sunny; the next, it was raining.
One minute it sunny; next raining.
One minute sunny; next the rain.
One minute was sunny; next it raining.
optionExplanations: 正確：one minute... the next... 呈現快速變化。
錯：兩個子句均不完整。
錯：缺少完整主詞與動詞。
錯：缺少 it，且進行式缺 be。
questions.explanation: 正確：one minute... the next... 呈現快速變化。

questions.word: 過去敘事中的 as：當……時
questions.meaning: as 可以表示兩件事同時發生；原歌詞 Listened 省略主詞。
questions.usage: 描述在朋友做飯時聽音樂。
questions.prompt: 我在朋友煮飯時聽音樂。哪句正確？
options: I listened to music as my friend cook dinner.
I listened to music as my friend cooking dinner.
I listened music as my friend cooked dinner.
I listened to music as my friend cooked dinner.
optionExplanations: 錯：過去敘事中 cook 應為 cooked。
錯：as 子句缺少 was。
錯：listen to music 才是正確搭配。
正確：as my friend cooked 表示同時發生。
questions.explanation: 正確：as my friend cooked 表示同時發生。

questions.meaning: 歌詞只用片語強調「一句真話也沒有」；一般完整句要有主詞和動詞。
questions.usage: 辨認歌詞片語和完整的日常英文句子。
questions.prompt: 表達會議中沒人回答問題。哪句是完整標準句？
options: There never answer at the meeting.
Never an answer at the meeting.
There was never an answer at the meeting.
optionExplanations: 錯：缺少動詞與介系詞。
錯：there 後須 be 動詞。
錯：這是歌詞式片語，不是完整句。
正確：there was never + 名詞是完整句。
questions.explanation: 正確：there was never + 名詞是完整句。

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 敵人；對手
questions.usage: 描述互相對立或競爭的人；enemy 比 opponent 更強烈。
options: The enemy was a good friend who helped us win.
The two countries saw each other as an enemy.
I wore an enemy to keep warm in winter.
The enemy is a place where we eat lunch.
optionExplanations: 把敵人說成協助自己獲勝的好朋友，沒有交代敵對轉變，與此題語境不符。
正確：兩國互相視為敵人，符合敵對關係。
enemy 是人或群體，不是能穿在身上的衣服。
enemy 不是吃午餐的地方。
questions.explanation: 正確：兩國互相視為敵人，符合敵對關係。

questions.meaning: 柱子；支柱
questions.usage: 談建築支撐結構，也可比喻一個計畫的重要支持。
options: She poured two pillars into her tea.
These stone pillars hold up the old roof.
The pillars ran to school before eight.
This pillar is a sound we hear at night.
optionExplanations: pillars 是柱子，不能像液體或粉末倒進茶裡。
正確：石柱支撐舊屋頂，符合建築用法。
柱子無法自己跑去上學。
pillar 不是聲音。
questions.explanation: 正確：石柱支撐舊屋頂，符合建築用法。

questions.meaning: 騎兵部隊
questions.usage: 用於歷史、軍事描述；與一般 infantry（步兵）不同。
options: We drank cavalry after the long walk.
The cavalry is a room where we keep books.
The cavalry cooked the road for dinner.
The cavalry rode horses across the field.
optionExplanations: cavalry 不是飲料。
騎兵是部隊，不是圖書室。
cavalry 是士兵部隊，不能用來表示煮馬路。
正確：騎兵騎馬穿越田野。
questions.explanation: 正確：騎兵騎馬穿越田野。

questions.meaning: 合唱團（複數）
questions.usage: 談多個一起唱歌的團體；單數是 choir。
options: I put three choirs in my coat pocket.
The two choirs sang together at the school show.
Two choirs repaired the broken buses with music.
The choirs were silent because they sang loudly.
optionExplanations: 合唱團不是能放進口袋的小物品。
正確：兩個合唱團在學校表演中一起唱歌。
合唱團可以唱歌，不是靠音樂來修理公車。
同時聲稱完全安靜又大聲唱歌，自相矛盾。
questions.explanation: 正確：兩個合唱團在學校表演中一起唱歌。

questions.meaning: 盾牌；保護物
questions.usage: 可指實際的防護盾，亦可比喻保護。
options: He used a shield to hear the song better.
I ate a shield because I missed lunch.
The soldier held a shield to protect himself.
She shielded at the bus for three tickets.
optionExplanations: 盾牌不能用來增強聽力。
盾牌不是食物。
正確：士兵持盾牌保護自己。
shield 作動詞需要合理受詞，這裡不能表示買車票。
questions.explanation: 正確：士兵持盾牌保護自己。

questions.meaning: 傳教士（複數）
questions.usage: 描述因宗教信仰而前往其他地方傳教的人；屬宗教語境。
options: We wore missionaries when the weather was cold.
The missionaries were five chairs in the hall.
The missionaries went abroad to teach their faith.
A missionary is a kind of mountain bike.
optionExplanations: 傳教士不是衣物。
傳教士是人，不是椅子。
正確：傳教士到海外傳播其信仰。
missionary 不表示腳踏車種類。
questions.explanation: 正確：傳教士到海外傳播其信仰。

questions.meaning: 外國的；外來的
questions.usage: 描述來自另一個國家的人、語言或事物。
options: She is learning a foreign language at school.
He foreigned his shoes before the match.
The soup is foreign because it is very hot.
This foreign is running late for the train.
optionExplanations: 正確：foreign language 表示外語。
foreign 不是動詞，不能表示穿鞋。
湯熱並不能說明它是否來自外國。
foreign 是形容詞，不能單獨代替遲到的人。
questions.explanation: 正確：foreign language 表示外語。

questions.meaning: 邪惡的；惡毒的；（非正式）很棒的
questions.usage: 描述惡意行為；口語也有完全不同的讚美用法，本題考負面義。
options: The bus was wicked because it had four wheels.
She put wicked in her bag before class.
The wicked king hurt people for no reason.
The wicked child was kind to everyone all day.
optionExplanations: 公車有四個輪子與邪惡無關。
wicked 是形容詞，不能當作東西裝入書包。
正確：國王無故傷害別人，符合負面義。
整天對大家好，缺少此處「惡毒」的證據。
questions.explanation: 正確：國王無故傷害別人，符合負面義。

questions.meaning: 碎裂的；粉碎的
questions.usage: 形容玻璃等破成碎片；也能比喻希望破滅。
options: She shattered to school before eight o’clock.
Our shattered tea tasted very sweet today.
The shattered window was new and not damaged.
The ball hit the glass and left it shattered.
optionExplanations: shatter 不能直接代替 go to school。
shattered 不自然地形容茶的甜度。
說窗戶已碎裂又沒有受損，語意衝突。
正確：球撞到玻璃使其碎裂。
questions.explanation: 正確：球撞到玻璃使其碎裂。

questions.meaning: 革命者；主張革命的人（複數）
questions.usage: 談試圖徹底改變政治或社會制度的人。
options: The revolutionaries wanted to change the government.
The revolutionaries are books with empty pages.
I ate revolutionaries with bread for breakfast.
The revolutionaries were a kind of winter coat.
optionExplanations: 正確：革命者希望改變政府。
革命者不是書籍。
革命者不是早餐食物。
革命者是人，不是外套。
questions.explanation: 正確：革命者希望改變政府。

questions.meaning: 木偶；傀儡
questions.usage: 可以是真正被操控的玩偶，也可比喻受別人控制的人。
options: She moved the puppet by pulling its strings.
The puppet was a drink with no sugar.
We used a puppet to make the room warmer.
I put the puppet on my feet like shoes.
optionExplanations: 正確：拉動線來操縱木偶，符合字面義。
木偶不是飲料。
木偶通常不能用於取暖。
木偶不是鞋子。
questions.explanation: 正確：拉動線來操縱木偶，符合字面義。

questions.meaning: 銀盤；銀製盤子
questions.usage: 表示用銀製成的盤子；歌中用作象徵性的歷史畫面。
options: The waiter silver plated us to our table.
My silver plate is a place to catch the train.
She read a silver plate to finish her book.
The cakes were served on a silver plate.
optionExplanations: silver plate 不能直接這樣當作「帶位」的動詞。
銀盤不是搭火車的地點。
銀盤不能替代書本閱讀內容。
正確：蛋糕放在銀盤上端出。
questions.explanation: 正確：蛋糕放在銀盤上端出。
